evidence: Carries the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label and heavily modifies `src/coins.*`, `src/txdb.*`, and `src/dbwrapper.*`.
rationale: Directly improves chainstate integrity by preventing LevelDB deserialization failures from masquerading as missing coins and removes the complex `CCoinsViewErrorCatcher` indirection layer. As the PR explains, `CDBWrapper::Read()` previously made corrupted data appear as non-existent keys and point-read failures bypassed fatal error notifications.
